noun_definition: Member refers to a user who has been invited to participate in a specific workspace within the application.
list of user refers to the collection of individuals displayed in the Members section of a workspace that can be navigated using the Up and Down arrow keys.
Workspace refers to a collaborative environment within the application where users can manage members and invite others to join.
Arrow refers to the Up and Down keys on the keyboard that are intended to scroll the user list in the workspace members section.
